title: City Advice
intro: Free advice for people who live in the City of London Square Mile or on a City of London Corporation estate.

blocks.heading: Check that you are eligible
paragraphs: The service is for residents of the Square Mile or a City of London estate. Check the City of London Corporation’s estate list and the service map if you are unsure.

blocks.heading: What we can help with
paragraphs: Benefits, housing, consumer rights, debt, employment rights and family issues.

blocks.heading: Get advice
paragraphs: Call 0800 808 5853 (8am–8pm, seven days a week), email city.advice@toynbeehall.org.uk or arrange a face-to-face appointment. Weekly drop-ins are held at Toynbee Hall on Thursdays, 10am–12pm, at 28 Commercial Street, London E1 6LS.
